questions.question: Give the team_fifa_api_id of teams with more than 50 but less than 60 build-up play speed.
questions.evidence: teams with more than 50 but less than 60 build-up play speed refers to buildUpPlaySpeed >50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed <60;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

questions.question: Give the name of the league had the most goals in the 2016 season?
questions.evidence: league that had the most goals refers to MAX(SUM(home_team_goal, away_team_goal)); 2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016';
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1.league_id = t2.id WHERE t1.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t2.name ORDER BY SUM(t1.home_team_goal + t1.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How was Francesco Migliore's attacking work rate on 2015/5/1?
questions.evidence: Francesco Migliore refers to player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'; on 2015/5/1 refers to date LIKE '2015-05-01%';
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.attacking_work_rate FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.`date` LIKE '2015-05-01%' AND t1.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'

questions.question: In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
questions.evidence: Final result should return the Team.team_long_name; Scotland Premier League refers to League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'; away team refers to away_team_api_id; away team that won the most refers to MAX(SUBTRACT(away_team_goal, home_team_goal) > 0); 2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'; won the most refers to MAX(COUNT(*));
questions.SQL: SELECT teamInfo.team_long_name FROM League AS leagueData INNER JOIN Match AS matchData ON leagueData.id = matchData.league_id INNER JOIN Team AS teamInfo ON matchData.away_team_api_id = teamInfo.team_api_id WHERE leagueData.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND matchData.season = '2009/2010' AND matchData.away_team_goal - matchData.home_team_goal > 0 GROUP BY matchData.away_team_api_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many football players born after the 1990s have the first name "Aaron"?
questions.evidence: first name "Aaron" refers to player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'; born after the 1990s refers to birthday > '1990'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player WHERE birthday > '1990' AND player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'

questions.question: What percentage is Landon Donovan's overall rating higher than Jordan Bowery on 2013/7/12?
questions.evidence: Landon Donovan's refers to player_name = 'Landon Donovan'; Jordan Bowery refers to player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'; percentage refers to DIVIDE(SUBTRACT(player_name = 'Landon Donovan' overall_rating; player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' overall_rating), player_name = 'Landon Donovan' overall_rating)*100
questions.SQL: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 - SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) LvsJ_percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_fifa_api_id = t2.player_fifa_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t2.`date`, 1, 10) = '2013-07-12'

questions.question: List the long name of teams with above-average build-up play passing in 2012.
questions.evidence: long name of teams refers to team_long_name; build-up play passing refers to buildUpPlayPassing; above-average build-up play passing = buildUpPlayPassing > DIVIDE(SUM(buildUpPlayPassing), COUNT(team_long_name) WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL); in 2012 refers to strftime('%Y', date) = '2012';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT t4.team_long_name FROM Team_Attributes AS t3 INNER JOIN Team AS t4 ON t3.team_api_id = t4.team_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t3.`date`, 1, 4) = '2012' AND t3.buildUpPlayPassing > ( SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.buildUpPlayPassing) AS REAL) / COUNT(t1.id) FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',t2.`date`) = '2012')

questions.question: Calculate the average overall rating of Pietro Marino.
questions.evidence: Pietro Marino refers to player_name = 'Pietro Marino'; average overall rating AVG(T1.overall_rating)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

questions.question: Among the players born before the year 1986, how many of them would remain in his position and defense while the team attacked?
questions.evidence: players born before the year 1986 refers to strftime('%Y', birthday)<'1986'; players who would remain in his position and defense while the team attacked refers to defensive_work_rate = 'high'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.player_name) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',t1.birthday) < '1986' AND t2.defensive_work_rate = 'high'

questions.question: Who are the players that tend to be attacking when their mates were doing attack moves? List down their name.
questions.evidence: tend to be attacking when their mates were doing attack moves refers to attacking_work_rate = 'high';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT t1.player_name FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

questions.question: List down most tallest players' name.
questions.evidence: tallest refers to rank based on the height in descending order; Most tallest players refers to rank = 1
questions.SQL: SELECT player_name FROM (SELECT player_name, height, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) as rank FROM Player) WHERE rank = 1

questions.question: What was the overall rating for Aaron Mooy on 2016/2/4?
questions.evidence: Aaron Mooy refers to player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'; on 2016/2/4 refers to date LIKE '2016-02-04%';
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.overall_rating FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t2.`date`, 1, 10) = '2016-02-04' AND t1.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'

questions.question: What was the average overall rating for Marko Arnautovic from 2007/2/22 to 2016/4/21?
questions.evidence: average overall rating refers to avg(overall_rating); Marko Arnautovic refers to player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'; from 2007/2/22 to 2016/4/21 refers to the first 10 characters of date BETWEEN '2007-02-22' and '2016-04-21'
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_fifa_api_id = t2.player_fifa_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(t2.`date`, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

questions.question: Give the name of the league had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season?
questions.evidence: league that had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season refers to MAX(league_name WHERE season = '2008/2009');
questions.SQL: SELECT t1.name FROM League AS t1 JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t2.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY t1.name HAVING COUNT(t2.id) = (SELECT MAX(match_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(t2.id) AS match_count FROM Match AS t2 WHERE t2.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY t2.league_id))

questions.question: Please list the names of the players whose volley score and dribbling score are over 70.
questions.evidence: volley score are over 70 refers to volleys > 70; dribbling score refers to dribbling are over 70 refers to dribbling > 70;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT t1.player_name FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.volleys > 70 AND t2.dribbling > 70

questions.question: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?
questions.evidence: finishing rate refers to finishing; highest average finishing rate = MAX(AVG(finishing)); highest football player refers to MAX(height); shortest football player refers to MIN(height);
questions.SQL: SELECT A FROM ( SELECT AVG(finishing) result, 'Max' A FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.height = ( SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player ) UNION SELECT AVG(finishing) result, 'Min' A FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.height = ( SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player ) ) ORDER BY result DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which player is the tallest?
questions.evidence: tallest player refers to MAX(height);
questions.SQL: SELECT player_name FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the short name of team who played safe while creating chance of passing?
questions.evidence: played safe while creating chance of passing refers to chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'; short name of team refers to team_short_name
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT t1.team_short_name FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

questions.question: From 2010 to 2015, what was the average overall rating of players who are higher than 170?
questions.evidence: from 2010 to 2015 refers to strftime('%Y', date) >= '2010' AND <= '2015'; average overall rating = SUM(t2.overall_rating)/ COUNT(t2.id); higher than 170 refers to Player.height > 170;
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 170 AND STRFTIME('%Y',t2.`date`) >= '2010' AND STRFTIME('%Y',t2.`date`) <= '2015'

questions.evidence: "FC Lorient" refers to team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'; on 2010/2/22 refers to date LIKE '2010-02-22%';
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t1.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND t2.`date` LIKE '2010-02-22%'

questions.question:
What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Diallo and Aaron Appindangoye
?
questions.evidence: difference of the average ball control = SUBTRACT(AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'), AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye')); AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'XX XX') = SUM(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN id ELSE NULL END)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id

questions.question: Please provide the full name of the away team that scored the most goals.
questions.evidence: full name refers to team_long_name; away team refers to away_team_api_id; scored the most goals refers to MAX(away_team_goal)
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.team_long_name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1.away_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id ORDER BY t1.away_team_goal DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which player is older, Aaron Lennon or Abdelaziz Barrada?
questions.evidence: The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
questions.SQL: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was the final score for the match on September 24, 2008, in the Belgian Jupiler League between the home team and the away team?
questions.evidence: September 24, 2008 refers to date like '2008-09-24%'; in the Belgian Jupiler League refers to League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'; final score for home team refers to home_team_goal; final score for away team refers to away_team_goal
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.home_team_goal, t2.away_team_goal FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t1.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND t2.`date` LIKE '2008-09-24%'

questions.question: When was the first time did Kevin Constant have his highest crossing score? Give the date.
questions.evidence: Kevin Constant refers to player_name = 'Kevin Constant'; highest crossing score refers to MAX(crossing)
questions.SQL: SELECT `date` FROM ( SELECT t2.crossing, t2.`date` FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_fifa_api_id = t2.player_fifa_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Kevin Constant' ORDER BY t2.crossing DESC) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
